I have collected data according to a published conceptual framework, and hence directly ran CFA on the data.

There are certain variables that are showing negative loadings (logically incorrect) and few standardised loadings are either greater than +1 or -1. If I eliminate these variables, one latent construct is only left with two items - for which the model fit is not estimated (like CFI and RMSEA etc.)

How could I deal with this?

Thank you
